name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels whose electric motor can produce 1,000 watts or more (or whose engine is 150 cc or more).

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle for each rider, and no more than three wheels on the ground (47 O.S. §1-135)
An electric motor capable of producing 1,000 watts or more, or a combustion engine of 150 cc or more; below that it's a motor-driven cycle or moped (47 O.S. §1-135)
Riders need a Class A, B, C or D license with a motorcycle endorsement; riders 17 and younger must complete a state-approved basic rider course
From 14, a restricted Class D license with a motorcycle-only restriction allows riding while accompanied by a licensed rider 21 or older in visual contact, until the rider passes the driving test
Riders under 16 may not ride on a highway with a posted minimum speed
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218
Needs two rear-view mirrors, a speedometer, fenders, a horn and a muffler, and a windshield or eye protection for the rider, except on trail rides off public roads
Registered with Service Oklahoma on the staggered yearly cycle
Riders under 16 may not carry passengers; older riders may carry one only on a factory double seat with footrests and wheels at least 12 inches in diameter
May not pass other vehicles between lanes of traffic
